subtopic: Reading 90 Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
question_en: Which of the following is a component of the Code of Ethics? CFA Institute members shall:
option_a: make reasonable efforts to detect and prevent violations by those who are under their supervision.
option_b: disclose to their employer all matters that reasonably could be expected to interfere with their duty to their employer or ability to make unbiased and objective recommendations.
option_c: strive to maintain and improve their competence and the competence of others in the profession.
explanation_en: Striving to maintain and improve their competence and the competence of others in the profession is one of the components of the Code of Ethics, whereas the other statements are part of the Standards of Professional Conduct.

pdf: D:\CLAUDE\Projet CFA\CFA L1\2. QB KAPLAN-3000 MCQs\QSTN WITH ANS\Ethical and professional standard\Reading 90 Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct - Answers.pdf
subtopic: Reading 90 Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
question_en: With respect to CFA Institute enforcement of the Code and Standards, possible disciplinary sanctions least likely include:
option_a: payment of a ne.
option_b: public censure.
option_c: suspension from participation in the CFA Program.
explanation_en: CFA Institute does not impose fines. CFA Institute may impose sanctions including public censure, suspension of a candidate from participation in the CFA program, or suspension or revocation of a member's right to use the CFA designation.

subtopic: Reading 90 Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
question_en: According to the Code of Ethics, which of the following statements is NOT correct? CFA Institute members are required to:
option_a: comply with the CFA Institute Global Investment Performance Standards.
option_b: maintain and improve their competence and strive to maintain the competence of others in the profession.
option_c: use reasonable care and exercise independent professional judgment.
explanation_en: The CFA Institute-GIPS are voluntary standards for the industry. Firms are not required to comply with these standards when presenting performance. The other statements are each components of the CFA Institute Code of Ethics.

subtopic: Reading 90 Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
question_en: According to the CFA Institute Code of Ethics, CFA Institute members shall:
option_a: preserve the confidentiality of information communicated by clients, prospects, or employers concerning investment matters.
option_b: act with integrity, competence, diligence, respect, and in an ethical manner when dealing with the public, clients, prospective clients, employers, employees, colleagues in the investment profession, and other participants in the global capital markets.
option_c: maintain knowledge and comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations.
explanation_en: Acting with integrity, competence, diligence, respect, and in an ethical manner when dealing with the public, clients, prospective clients, employers, employees, colleagues in the investment profession, and other participants in the global capital markets is one of the six components of the Code of Ethics, whereas the other statements are part of the Standards of Professional Conduct.

subtopic: Reading 90 Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
question_en: The CFA Institute's Professional Conduct Program may learn about potential violations of the Code and Standards by members and candidates:
option_a: from sources other than written complaints or members and candidates self- reporting.
option_b: only from written complaints or members and candidates self-reporting.
option_c: only from members and candidates self-reporting.
explanation_en: In addition to self-reporting by members and candidates and written complaints about members and candidates, the Professional Conduct Program may learn about potential violations through public sources such as the news media, through reports from CFA exam proctors, by review of exam results and materials, or through monitoring of online and social media activity.

subtopic: Reading 90 Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct
question_en: Liam McCoy has lunch with a wealthy client whose portfolio he manages. McCoy advises the client to double his current position in the JKM Corporation due to an anticipated increase in sales. In accordance with Standard (V) Investment Analysis, Recommendations and Actions, when McCoy returns to his office he should:
option_a: verify the suitability of the investment recommendation before placing the client's order.
option_b: identify other clients for whom JKM may be a suitable investment and notify them immediately of his recommendation.
option_c: document the details of the conversation with the client with regard to his investment recommendation.
explanation_en: Standard V(C) Record Retention requires that Members and Candidates document all recommendation and communications with clients. McCoy should document the details of the conversation, including any resulting investment decisions and/or actions. The suitability of the investment should have already been considered before the recommendation and McCoy should not execute the order until the client instructs him to. Identifying other clients for this investment would fall under Standard III(B) Fair Dealing.

question_en: According to the Code of Ethics, a member reflects credit on the profession when a member:
